correctness.rationale: Exact p and q formulas from the Dirichlet–multinomial count pmf; covariance sign equals R-1. The derivative of log R is a positive Laplace integral of a strictly convex discrete second difference. The strict convexity derivative bracket is certified analytically by B(0)=B'(0)=0, B''(x)=x exp(x)>0; boundary m=2 separately yields joint probability zero. Rational endpoint formulas, the binomial lower bound, and the translated positive polynomial certify sign for all integers m. Exact standalone enumeration checks support the algebra but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: At m+1 draws the population first crosses the number-of-colours boundary, a natural frequency-spectrum test case. A complete all-m classification reveals a genuine phase transition between negative and positive pairwise singleton dependence as reinforcement strength changes, despite negative count correlations. Monotonicity and uniqueness are mathematically substantive and motivate understanding singleton co-occurrence under overdispersed categorical sampling.
